links.note: Was 30853 (agriculture and allied activities, i.e. the sector's share of national output), which the item never touches: it asks what share of the rural agricultural workforce is women. This chapter's 19 concepts contain nothing on farm labour or women in agriculture, so nothing in the closed set is right. Cleared.
Was 30853. Same women-in-the-workforce percentage as its twin above, and the same reasoning: no concept covers farm labour. Cleared.

Was 30849 (what makes a good farmer - care of cattle, knowing the seasons), which has nothing to do with the average size of an Indian landholding. No concept covers landholdings or farm economics. Cleared.

Was 30853 (the sector's share of output). The item is an assertion-reason about the Ganga basin failing to replenish itself as Himalayan glaciers melt; the chapter's concept set stops at government support and covers none of its environmental-stress material. Cleared.

Was 30861 (plant and soil as one system, farmyard manure), which is not what drip irrigation is about. The set has no irrigation concept - the same reason I left the sprinkler and drip short answers unlinked. Cleared.

Was 30861 (plant and soil as one system). The Phad system is a documented traditional practice, which is 30864 - ICAR's inventory of nearly 5,000 such practices - not a statement about soil nutrition.

Was 30851 (the definition of what farming includes). Organic farming's principles are 30861's: the plant and the whole soil ecosystem treated as one system, fed by farmyard manure rather than bought inputs.

Was 30863 (terrace farming), which the item never mentions. Why Tamil Nadu and West Bengal can grow rice all year is a matter of climate and water availability, which is 30855 (geography and climate determining the crop).
